claim_boundary: This result concerns a 16-point Boolean registry, exact-size event coverage, fresh fair fallback bits, independent challenges, and two declared suppression models. It does not establish real meter coverage, identify a deployment threshold, characterize adaptive history-dependent suppression, prove transformation-universal attestability, or resolve ASMP-7.

claim_support.claim: On the frozen Boolean grid, selective suppression can create an exact common-law region and otherwise weakly increases audit burden relative to policy-independent coverage.

anti_gaming.probe: nominal independent coverage cannot substitute for selective worst-case coverage

clean_control.probe: both models collapse to the v0.2.1 full-coverage experiment

invariance.probe: all n=4 input relabelings preserve attainable covered-agreement sets

monotonicity.probe: more exact coverage never increases certified burden on the frozen grid

sensitivity.probe: sample burden responds to coverage loss and selective suppression

operational_decision.reason: synthetic finite registry with no validated real-meter or deployment bridge

task_result.basis: exact comparison of policy-independent coverage and adversarial selective suppression
